title: M$^3$R-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multimodal Metaphor Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2608.05817v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal metaphor understanding requires identifying cross-domain Target-Source mappings and inferring sentiment from visual and textual evidence. However, existing benchmarks largely evaluate these subtasks separately and lack evidence-grounded explanations, limiting their ability to assess coherent cross-modal reasoning. To enable unified and evidence-grounded evaluation, we introduce M$^3$R-Bench, a benchmark of 1,000 human-annotated image-text instances with joint labels for metaphor occurrence, Target-Source mapping, and sentiment, alongside stage-wise explanations for evidence identification, mapping establishment, and sentiment inference. Evaluations reveal that existing models frequently rely on textual shortcuts and produce Target-Source mappings inconsistent with visual evidence. To address this evidence-mapping mismatch, we propose M$^3$R-Reasoner, which combines curriculum-based reasoning supervision with task-aware rei

translated_title: M³R-Bench：一个面向证据支撑的多模态隐喻理解的统一基准
translated_abstract: 多模态隐喻理解需要识别跨领域的“目标-源”映射，并从视觉和文本证据中推断情感。然而，现有基准大多将这些子任务分开评估，且缺乏基于证据的解释，限制了其评估连贯跨模态推理的能力。为了实现统一且基于证据的评估，我们提出了M³R-Bench，这是一个包含1,000个人工标注图文实例的基准，为隐喻出现、“目标-源”映射和情感提供联合标签，并附有针对证据识别、映射建立和情感推断的分阶段解释。评估结果显示，现有模型经常依赖文本捷径，产生与视觉证据不一致的“目标-源”映射。为了解决这种证据与映射不匹配的问题，我们提出了M³R-Reasoner，它将基于课程学习的推理监督与任务感知的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了M³R-Bench统一基准，包含1000个人工标注的图文实例，联合标注隐喻出现、目标-源映射与情感并提供分阶段解释，同时设计了M³R-Reasoner模型以解决现有模型依赖文本捷径、映射结果与视觉证据不一致的问题。
en_tdlr: M³R-Bench is a unified benchmark of 1,000 human-annotated image-text instances with joint labels for metaphor occurrence, Target-Source mapping, and sentiment along with stage-wise explanations, and the proposed M³R-Reasoner addresses the evidence-mapping mismatch caused by existing models' reliance on textual shortcuts.
